description: Implement vekd Phase 4.5 Web UI: the htmx-based admin dashboard served on port 8080. This is the ONLY management interface for vekd - all app deployment, configuration, and monitoring happens through this web UI.
steps: Create src/vekd/vekd_web.c and vekd_web.h - The web UI HTTP server and route handlers. Reuse the existing HTTP server/router pattern from src/http_server.c and src/router.c but adapted for vekd's admin interface.
Implement the login page (GET /login, POST /login) with session cookie-based authentication. On first boot, display the initial password that was generated during setup.
Implement the dashboard page (GET /dashboard) showing: list of deployed apps with status indicators, system resource usage (memory, CPU from /proc), and quick action buttons.

Implement app management pages: GET /apps/new (deploy form), POST /apps (create app), GET /apps/:id (app detail with env vars, deploy history, logs), POST /apps/:id/deploy (trigger deploy), POST /apps/:id/stop, POST /apps/:id/start, POST /apps/:id/restart.
Implement environment variable management: GET /apps/:id/env (list env vars), POST /apps/:id/env (set env var), DELETE /apps/:id/env/:key (unset env var). Values encrypted at rest via master key.
Implement log tailing: GET /apps/:id/logs - shows recent log output with htmx polling for live updates.

Implement settings pages: GET /settings/users, POST /settings/users (add user), GET /settings/cloudflare, POST /settings/cloudflare (set API token), GET /settings/backup, POST /settings/backup (trigger backup).

Create src/vekd/vekd_templates.c and vekd_templates.h - Server-side HTML rendering using C string building (similar to the view system in stdlib_view.c). Include htmx script tag, basic CSS, and layout template.
Implement htmx-based interactions: deploy buttons use hx-post with swap for status updates, log tailing uses hx-get with hx-trigger='every 2s', env var forms use hx-post for inline editing.
Add the vekd web UI routes to the build and verify the dashboard is accessible.
acceptance_criteria: The vekd binary serves the admin web UI on port 8080
Login page authenticates users and sets a session cookie
Dashboard shows list of apps with their current status
Users can create new apps, deploy, stop, start, restart, and delete apps entirely through the web UI
Environment variables can be managed (set/unset) through the web UI
Log output is visible and updates in near-real-time via htmx polling
Settings pages allow user management and Cloudflare token configuration
All HTML is server-rendered with htmx for interactivity (no client-side framework)
verification: Run 'make -C /projects/sandbox/vek vekd' and confirm compilation succeeds with the web UI code included
Run 'make -C /projects/sandbox/vek test' and confirm all tests pass
findings: Build succeeds with zero warnings for vekd sources. All unit tests pass (16/16 vekd_db tests). Integration test failures (control_flow, stdlib_form, stdlib_pages, strings) are pre-existing issues in the vek language runtime and unrelated to vekd. The Makefile SHARED_OBJS now includes http_server.o, event_loop.o, router.o, http_parser.o for the vekd link step.
